Azkari is the best Android application for remembrances and supplications Prayers and Masbaha. Azkari is designed to enable you to read the daily remembrances and supplications easily and in a simple way on your mobile.

Start using Al masbaha with the name of the tasbeeha you selected, which also contains a counter and a time. You can also control the sound of the masbaha and set it to mute or loud by clicking the sound icon at the bottom of the screen. Also, you can set whether you want the Shahed to be shown or not by checking the checkbox in the bar at the bottom. You can pause the Masbaha by clicking on the pause icon in the bar at the bottom and resume by clicking on the resume icon on the pause dialog. Once you click the back button, the new values of timers and counters are updated, and available for you through the log screen, at the options menu.

This screen shows the chosen prayers sequentially and according to their repetitions. You can share the one you want through bluetooth, Gmail, Email, skype, twitter and Facebook ... ect, by clicking one of three sharing icon in the bar at the bottom of the screen. You can also listen to the recitation one after another by clicking the icon at the bottom of the screen or listen to all of them by clicking the auto play button. Moreover you can know the advantage of the prayer by clicking the star icon in the bar at the bottom of the screen .When you finish reading, the new values of the timer and the counter will be updated if you read all the related prayers and will be available for you through the log screen , and you can mute sound effects using speaker icon , at the options menu. Please note that Twitter account will not work unless the time and date settings on your device are set correctly.

You can add new Tasbeeha by clicking Add Tasbeeha at the bottom of the tasabeeh screen under the Tasabeeh tab. A dialog is shown where you can enter the text of your new tasbeeha. Once you add it, you can start using Al-Masbaha with your new custom tasbeeha by clicking it from the tasabeeh screen.

In this screen you can setup the daily notifications for Morning Prayers, Evening Prayers, Remembrance before sleeping and Remembrance when waking up. \n Also you can disable the notifications by long touch.
You can only delete user-defined ones. To delete a tasbeeha keep pressing on the item you want to remove and confirm that you want to remove it by clicking ok in the dialog that will be shown.

You can access the log screen by clicking the menu button and choose Log item. This screen shows the log of the counter and timer of all your prayers and azkar. You can reset them by clicking the item you want to reset and confirming your choice from the dialog that will be shown when you click the item.

This screen shows you several choices to set for the application :
 Facebook Account : you can log out from your fb account by clicking the log out button. 
 Twitter Account : you can log out from your twitter account by clicking the log out button .
 Language : you can choose the language of the application by clicking the languages spinner and selecting the language you want. 
 Prayers text font size : you can choose the text size of the prayers by clicking the Prayers text font size spinner and selecting the size you want. 
 Volume : you can set the sound to mute or not mute. 
 Vibration : you can set the device to vibrate or not when running Azkari. 
 
 Note : Twitter account will not work unless the time and date settings of your device are set correctly.

By using Azkari you can easily read the prayers and supplications as received from the Prophet PBU in addition to the Masbaha that looks like the real one. for more info about this application and more applications you can visit us at :

In the main page of Azkari application you can see two tabs : the first one for prayers and the second for al-tasabeeh. 
 If you select the prayers tab it will display the list of prayers like morning prayers, evening prayers ... etc. Choose any of them and start reading the chosen prayers. 
 If you select the tasbeehat tab it will display the list of tasbeehat like subhanallah, al-hamdulellah ... etc. Choose the one you want to start using al-masbaha. 
 You can share Islamic informations and your opinion about the application with your friends and Azkari users by using the sharing bar at the bottom of the main screen. The sharing bar contains three options : Native sharing to share via Bluetooth, Gmail, Email, Barcode, Skype … ect. Facebook sharing to add comment on Azkari page on Facebook. Twitter sharing to tweet for Azkari page on Twitter. 
 The main screen also contains the options menu. To show this menu, click on the menu button on your device. The options menu contains five options : help, Log, Settings, Daily Notifications and About Azkari.

Azkari widget displays the name of the tasbeeha and a timer in addition to a button. You can select the tasbeeha and start tasbeeh without the need to open Azkari. \n Note: after 5 seconds of not interacting with the widget values of timers and counters are updated, and the widget will be restarted.
